hooks.name: infra-copilot-session-start
hooks.command: r="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; if [ -n "$r" ] && [ ! -f "${r%/}/hooks/session-start.sh" ]; then r=""; fi; if [ -z "$r" ] && [ -f ./hooks/session-start.sh ]; then r="."; fi; [ -n "$r" ] || exit 0; CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT="${r%/}" sh "${r%/}/hooks/session-start.sh"
hooks.description: Announce that infra-copilot is installed when the working directory looks like a managed infra repo.
